arguments.command:
@'
import json, os
from hone.hone import Hone
from hone.utils import parse_json_file, parse_csv_file, CSVUtils
root = r"tests/fixtures/data_file"
h = Hone()
checks = {}
for name in ["comma_test","quotes_test","small_cats_dataset"]:
    csv = os.path.join(root,name,"dataset.csv")
    exp = parse_json_file(os.path.join(root,name,"nested_dataset.json"))
    checks["golden_"+name] = (h.convert(csv) == exp)
sch = parse_json_file(os.path.join(root,"small_cats_dataset","nested_schema.json"))
csv = os.path.join(root,"small_cats_dataset","dataset.csv")
checks["E3_schema_convert"] = (Hone().convert(csv, schema=sch) == parse_json_file(os.path.join(root,"small_cats_dataset","nested_dataset.json")))
checks["E3_get_schema"] = (Hone().get_schema(csv) == sch)
schema = {"name":"name","birth":{"day":"birth day"},"missing":"nope"}
got = Hone().convert(csv, schema=schema)
checks["E21_missing_omitted"] = (got[0] == {"name":"Tommy","birth":{"day":"11"}})
checks["E21_json_string"] = (Hone().convert(csv, schema=json.dumps(schema)) == got)
checks["E14_shapes"] = ([len(parse_csv_file(os.path.join(root,n,"dataset.csv"))[0]) for n in ["comma_test","quotes_test","small_cats_dataset"]] == [2,9,8])
checks["E14_headers"] = (CSVUtils(os.path.join(root,"comma_test","column_names.csv")).get_column_names() == ['"test","ing"', ' "beep"""'])
for k,v in checks.items(): print(("PASS" if v else "FAIL"), k)
print("ALL", all(checks.values()))
'@ | python -
